correctness.rationale: Unimodular tree incidence minors and the Cauchy--Binet Gram determinant give determinant n. Each omitted-edge parallelotope facet area is sqrt(s(n-s)) from a fully normalized dual-cut vector. Connectedness of the k-balanced edge core yields F_k <= n-2k+1 and equality conditions for both second extrema; two- and three-leaf extremality is proved with n=5 handled separately. Cayley counting accounts exactly for both sides and the pair of facets; a uniform Stirling expansion yields a harmonic main sum and O(n^(3/2)) remainder. The separate checker confirms finite cases but none is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: All tree graphical zonotopes of fixed order share intrinsic volume sqrt(n) and identical mean width, but their intrinsic boundary areas vary by shape. This theorem determines the full sharp first-to-second hierarchy with a surprisingly identical gap at both extremes, as well as an exact random-labeled expectation whose leading n^(3/2) log n scale is substantially different from deterministic minimal and maximal scales. Those are natural, interpretable geometric distinctions, not arbitrary parameter slices.
